opus.problem: The clues skip some of Abraham's best-known stories: God calling him to leave his country for a land He would show him (Genesis 12:1), the promise of descendants as many as the stars (Genesis 15:5), and Isaac's birth when Abraham was a hundred years old (Genesis 21:5). Burying his wife at Machpelah is a smaller detail. It is also not unique to him, since Jacob says he buried Leah there too (Genesis 49:31). Replace this clue with one of the better-known stories.
